documents.name: HCCPL/QMS/POL-001
documents.title: Quality Policy
documents.body_content:
QUALITY POLICY

Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited is committed to delivering products that perform reliably in their intended applications, with a strong focus on application engineering.

We ensure consistent, defect-free output through continual improvement of our manufacturing processes and quality systems, while providing accurate technical guidance for correct product use.

We are committed to maintain an effective integrated Management System in compliance with the applicable National and International standards for continual improvements.

We are dedicated to customer satisfaction and continuous improvement in line with ISO standards—ensuring quality proven in application.

Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited is committed to comply with the applicable Legal and Statutory requirements.

HATIM A. MOGUL
Managing Director
Date: 01-JAN-2026

গুণমান নীতি

Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited নির্ধারিত প্রয়োগে নির্ভরযোগ্যভাবে কার্যকর এমন পণ্য সরবরাহে প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ, যেখানে অ্যাপ্লিকেশন ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং-এর উপর বিশেষ গুরুত্ব প্রদান করা হয়।

আমরা আমাদের উৎপাদন প্রক্রিয়া এবং গুণমান ব্যবস্থার ধারাবাহিক উন্নতির মাধ্যমে সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ ও ত্রুটিমুক্ত উৎপাদন নিশ্চিত করি, পাশাপাশি পণ্যের সঠিক ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করতে নির্ভুল প্রযুক্তিগত দিকনির্দেশনা প্রদান করি।

আমরা প্রযোজ্য জাতীয় ও আন্তর্জাতিক মানদণ্ডের সাথে সামঞ্জস্য রেখে একটি কার্যকর সমন্বিত ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি (Integrated Management System) বজায় রাখতে প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ, যা ধারাবাহিক উন্নয়ন নিশ্চিত করে।

আমরা গ্রাহক সন্তুষ্টি এবং ধারাবাহিক উন্নয়নে প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ, ISO মানদণ্ডের সাথে সামঞ্জস্য রেখে—যা প্রয়োগে প্রমাণিত গুণমান নিশ্চিত করে।

Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited প্রযোজ্য সকল আইনগত ও বিধিবদ্ধ প্রয়োজনীয়তা মেনে চলতে প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ।

HATIM A. MOGUL
Managing Director
Date: 01-JAN-2026

गुणवत्ता नीति

Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited अपने उत्पादों को उनके निर्धारित उपयोग में विश्वसनीय प्रदर्शन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है, जिसमें एप्लिकेशन इंजीनियरिंग पर विशेष ध्यान दिया जाता है।

हम अपनी विनिर्माण प्रक्रियाओं और गुणवत्ता प्रणालियों के निरंतर सुधार के माध्यम से सुसंगत और दोषरहित उत्पादन सुनिश्चित करते हैं, साथ ही उत्पाद के सही उपयोग के लिए सटीक तकनीकी मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करते हैं।

हम लागू राष्ट्रीय और अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानकों के अनुरूप एक प्रभावी एकीकृत प्रबंधन प्रणाली (Integrated Management System) को बनाए रखने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध हैं, जिससे निरंतर सुधार सुनिश्चित होता है।

हम ग्राहक संतुष्टि और निरंतर सुधार के प्रति समर्पित हैं, जो ISO मानकों के अनुरूप है—और यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि गुणवत्ता का प्रदर्शन वास्तविक उपयोग में प्रमाणित हो।

Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited सभी लागू कानूनी और वैधानिक आवश्यकताओं का पालन करने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।

HATIM A. MOGUL
Managing Director
Date: 01-JAN-2026

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for the creation, review, approval, issue, revision, distribution, storage, retention, and disposal of documented information to ensure that only current and approved documents are available at the point of use.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all documented information forming part of the Quality Management System of Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd., including internal and external documents, maintained in electronic or hard copy format.

definitions.definition: Information defining requirements, procedures, or specifications.
Evidence that an activity has been performed.
Approved document subject to revision control.
Superseded document retained only for reference.
Company's electronic document management system used for maintaining controlled documents and records.

responsibilities.responsibility: Approve the Quality Manual, Quality Policy, and major QMS documents. Ensure adequate resources for document control.
Maintain document control. Issue revisions. Maintain the Master Document Register.
Review documents applicable to their department. Ensure only current documents are used. Identify the need for document revisions.
Use only approved documents. Prevent unauthorized modification of documents. Report any outdated or incorrect documents to the Quality Department.

procedure_steps.step_content: Documents are prepared by authorized personnel using the approved format and unique document numbering system.
All QMS documents shall be reviewed and approved prior to issue by authorized personnel.

Each document shall contain:

  • Document Number
  • Title
  • Revision No.
  • Issue Date
  • Page Number
Controlled documents shall be made available through the ERPNext document management system. Uncontrolled copies shall be identified accordingly.
Changes shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded. Superseded versions shall be withdrawn from use.
Applicable standards, customer drawings, specifications, and supplier documents shall be identified and controlled.
Documents and records shall be stored, protected, retained, and disposed of in accordance with the Record Retention Register.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic approach for identifying, evaluating, controlling, and monitoring risks and opportunities that may affect the Quality Management System (QMS), customer satisfaction, product quality, and business performance of Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all business processes, including sales, design, procurement, production, inspection, dispatch, customer service, and support functions.

definitions.definition: Effect of uncertainty that may negatively impact objectives or processes.
Circumstances that may improve performance, efficiency, or customer satisfaction.
Document used to record identified risks, opportunities, actions, and status.

responsibilities.responsibility: Review significant business risks and approve mitigation plans.
Maintain the Risk & Opportunity Register. Monitor implementation of actions. Present risk status during Management Review Meetings.
Identify process-specific risks and opportunities. Implement and monitor agreed actions.
Report potential risks or improvement opportunities to their department head.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Risks and opportunities shall be identified through:

  • Management Review Meetings
  • Customer feedback and complaints
  • Internal and external audits
  • Process performance monitoring.
  • Supplier evaluations
  • Production and quality issues
  • Market and statutory changes

Each identified risk shall be evaluated based on:

  • Likelihood of occurrence
  • Potential impact
  • Existing controls(if any)

Risks shall be prioritized for appropriate action.

Appropriate actions may include:

  • Eliminating the risk
  • Reducing the likelihood or impact
  • Establishing additional controls
  • Assigning responsibilities
  • Setting completion timelines

Opportunities for improvement shall also be documented and implemented where feasible.

The Quality Manager shall periodically review the Risk & Opportunity Register to verify:

  • Completion of planned actions
  • Effectiveness of implemented controls.
  • Need for additional actions.

The register shall be reviewed during Management Review Meetings or whenever significant changes to the organization, or its processes occur.

sop.purpose: To ensure that personnel performing work affecting product quality are competent based on appropriate education, training, skills, and experience, and are aware of the Quality Management System and their responsibilities.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all permanent, contractual, trainee, apprentice, and temporary employees working at Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.definition: Ability to perform assigned duties based on education, training, skills, and experience.
Planned activity to improve employee knowledge and skills.
Orientation provided to newly joined employees regarding company policies, safety, and the QMS.

responsibilities.responsibility: Provide adequate resources for recruitment and training. Review competency requirements.
Maintain employee records. Coordinate induction and training programs. Maintain training records.
Identify competency requirements. Recommend training needs. Evaluate employee performance and effectiveness of training.
Attend assigned training programs. Apply acquired knowledge in their work. Follow company procedures and work instructions.

procedure_steps.step_content: • Personnel shall be recruited based on the qualification, experience, and competency requirements of the respective position.

All new employees shall undergo induction training covering:

  • Company profile
  • Quality Policy and Quality Objectives
  • QMS awareness
  • Safety requirements
  • Departmental responsibilities
  • Applicable procedures and work instructions

Department Heads shall periodically assess employee competency based on:

  • Education and qualifications
  • Experience
  • Job performance
  • Skill level
  • Training effectiveness

Training may include:

  • Technical training
  • Quality awareness
  • Process-specific training.
  • Safety training
  • Customer-specific requirements
  • Equipment or machine operation

Training may be conducted internally or externally.

The effectiveness of training shall be evaluated through one or more of the following:

  • Observation of job performance
  • Practical demonstration
  • Supervisor feedback
  • Skill assessment
  • Reduction in errors or nonconformities

Additional training shall be provided where necessary.

Employees shall be made aware of:

  • The Quality Policy
  • Quality Objectives
  • Their contribution to product quality
  • Customer requirements
  • Consequences of nonconforming work

sop.declared_title: Customer Communication, Sales & Contract Review Procedure
sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for receiving customer enquiries, reviewing customer requirements, preparing quotations, accepting orders, and maintaining effective communication to ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and fulfilled.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all enquiries, quotations, purchase orders, contracts, amendments, and customer communications related to products and services provided by Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.definition: A request for quotation, technical information, or product details received from a customer.
Verification of customer requirements before accepting an order.
Official order issued by the customer for the supply of products or services.
Commercial offer issued by the organization based on reviewed customer requirements.

responsibilities.responsibility: Approve special commercial or contractual conditions when required.
Receive customer enquiries. Prepare quotations. Coordinate with customers. Obtain order confirmation.
Review drawings, samples, and technical specifications. Confirm technical feasibility.
Confirm manufacturing capability and delivery schedule.
Review quality, inspection, testing, and statutory requirements where applicable.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Customer enquiries may be received through:

  • Email
  • Telephone
  • Customer visit
  • Online portal
  • Tender documents

The Sales Department shall record the enquiry and collect all applicable technical and commercial requirements.

Customer requirements shall be reviewed to confirm:

  • Product specifications
  • Drawings or samples
  • Material grade
  • Quantity
  • Delivery schedule
  • Inspection requirements
  • Testing requirements
  • Packaging requirements
  • Statutory or regulatory requirements (if applicable)

Any ambiguity shall be clarified with the customer before submission of the quotation.

The Sales Department shall prepare the quotation based on approved technical and commercial inputs.

The quotation shall include, where applicable:

  • Product description
  • Quantity
  • Price
  • Delivery period
  • Payment terms
  • Validity
  • Applicable taxes
  • Special conditions

• Upon receipt of the Purchase Order, the Sales Department shall verify that it matches the quoted technical and commercial requirements.
  • Any deviations shall be resolved with the customer before acceptance.
  • Order acknowledgement shall be issued where applicable.

Accepted orders shall be communicated to the concerned departments for planning and execution.

Customer communication shall be maintained regarding:

  • Order status.
  • Delivery schedule
  • Technical clarifications
  • Design changes.
  • Customer complaints
  • Product feedback
  • After-sales support

• Any change requested by the customer after order acceptance shall be reviewed for its impact on quality, cost, delivery, and production.
  • Approved changes shall be documented and communicated to all affected departments before implementation to ensure relevant documented information is updated.

sop.purpose: To ensure that all externally provided products, materials, and services conform to specified purchase requirements through systematic supplier selection, evaluation, purchasing, and performance monitoring.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to the procurement of raw materials, bought-out components, consumables, subcontracted processes, equipment, services, and other externally provided products required by Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.definition: External provider of products or services.
Supplier evaluated and approved by Hatim Carbon.
Official document issued to procure materials or services.
A process performed by an external provider under the control of Hatim Carbon.

responsibilities.responsibility: Approve critical suppliers when required.
Identify and evaluate suppliers. Issue Purchase Orders. Monitor supplier performance.
Define quality requirements. Verify supplier quality documents. Review supplier performance.
Verify received quantity and documents. Coordinate incoming inspection.
Provide technical specifications or material requirements where applicable.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Suppliers shall be selected based on:

  • Product quality
  • Technical capability
  • Delivery performance
  • Commercial terms
  • Previous performance
  • Certifications (where applicable)

New suppliers shall be evaluated before approval.

Evaluation may consider:

  • Product samples
  • Manufacturing capability
  • Past performance
  • Customer references
  • Quality certifications

Approved suppliers shall be listed in the REG007 - Approved Supplier List.

Purchase Orders shall clearly specify:

  • Product description
  • Material grade
  • Quantity
  • Applicable drawings/specifications
  • Delivery schedule
  • Inspection requirements
  • Packaging requirements
  • Commercial terms

Only authorized personnel shall issue Purchase Orders.

Supplier performance shall be periodically reviewed based on:

  • Quality of supplied materials
  • On-time delivery
  • Responsiveness
  • Complaint history
  • Corrective action implementation
  • Rejection Rate

Unsatisfactory suppliers may be re-evaluated or removed from the Approved Supplier List.
Where any process is outsourced, Hatim Carbon shall ensure that applicable quality requirements are communicated, monitored, and verified before acceptance.

• Any change to an issued Purchase Order shall be reviewed and approved by authorized personnel before being communicated to the supplier.
  • The revised requirements shall clearly identify the changes made.
  • Where applicable, affected departments shall be informed of the revised purchase requirements.

sop.purpose: To ensure that all incoming materials are verified against specified purchase requirements before acceptance for production and are properly identified to maintain traceability.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all incoming raw materials, bought-out components, consumables, packing materials, and outsourced products received by Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

references.reference: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4 – Control of Externally Provided Processes, Products and Services

definitions.definition: Verification of received materials against specified requirements before acceptance.
Material approved for production after inspection.
Material not meeting specified requirements and segregated to prevent unintended use.
Supplier-issued document confirming the material conforms to specified chemical, mechanical, or other technical requirements.

responsibilities.responsibility: Coordinate with suppliers regarding rejected materials. Arrange replacement or corrective action where required.
Carry out incoming inspection. Verify specifications and quality requirements. Approve or reject received materials.
Receive incoming materials. Verify quantity and accompanying documents. Present materials for inspection.

procedure_steps.step_content:
On receipt, the Stores Department shall verify:

  • Delivery Challan
  • Purchase Order
  • Invoice
  • Quantity Received
  • Material Identification
  • Material Test Certificate (where applicable)

The Quality Department shall inspect the material as applicable by:

  • Visual inspection
  • Dimensional verification
  • Material grade verification
  • Quantity verification
  • Review of Material Test Certificate
  • Any additional tests specified in the Purchase Order or inspection plan.

Accepted materials shall be identified using appropriate labels, batch numbers, heat numbers, lot numbers or supplier identification, as applicable, to maintain identification and traceability throughout storage and production.
Materials meeting the specified purchase and inspection requirements shall be accepted, identified with an acceptance status (where applicable), and released to Stores for production use.

Materials failing to meet specified requirements shall:

  • Be clearly identified.
  • Be segregated from accepted material.
  • Be recorded.
  • Be reported to the Purchase Department for appropriate disposition.

Nonconforming materials shall be handled in accordance with SOP013 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs Procedure.
Accepted materials shall be stored in designated locations to prevent damage, deterioration, contamination, or mix-up before issue to production.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for planning, scheduling, monitoring, and controlling production activities to ensure that customer requirements are fulfilled efficiently, and products are manufactured in accordance with approved specifications.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all production activities carried out at Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd., from receipt of a confirmed customer order through production planning until the product is submitted for final inspection and subsequent dispatch.

definitions.definition: A schedule prepared to meet customer delivery requirements.
Document containing manufacturing and inspection requirements for a production batch.
A defined quantity of products manufactured under similar conditions.
Planned sequence and timing of manufacturing activities to meet customer delivery requirements.

responsibilities.responsibility: Execute production as per the approved Job Card, drawings, and work instructions. Report production delays or abnormalities.
Prepare production plans and schedules. Allocate manpower, machines, and resources. Monitor production progress.
Carry out stage and final inspections as per the Inspection Plan. Ensure production complies with approved specifications.
Issue materials against approved requisitions. Maintain material availability.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Production planning shall be carried out based on:

  • Customer Purchase Orders
  • Delivery schedules
  • Product specifications
  • Material availability
  • Machine capacity
  • Manpower availability
  • Customer priority (where applicable)

The Production Department shall prepare a production schedule indicating:

  • Product
  • Quantity
  • Batch
  • Planned start date.
  • Planned completion date.
  • Delivery commitment

Production shall commence only after confirming the availability of:

  • Approved raw materials
  • Required machinery
  • Qualified manpower
  • Applicable drawings
  • Work Instructions
  • Inspection and measuring equipment

Raw materials shall be issued by the Stores Department against an approved Material Requisition or Job Card.

Only accepted materials shall be issued for production.

Production shall be carried out in accordance with:

  • Approved drawings
  • Customer specifications
  • Work Instructions
  • Inspection requirements
  • Approved process parameters

Production progress shall be monitored and recorded throughout the manufacturing process.
Any change affecting production, process parameters, materials or specifications shall be reviewed, approved, and communicated to all affected departments before implementation.
Production records shall be maintained for each batch to ensure traceability and facilitate monitoring of production activities.

sop.purpose: To establish a controlled manufacturing process that ensures products are produced consistently in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, customer requirements, and applicable work instructions.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all manufacturing activities carried out at Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd. for carbon brushes, brush holders, slip rings, carbon blocks, and other carbon products.

definitions.definition: A detailed document describing how a specific manufacturing operation is performed.
Planned activities to ensure manufacturing is carried out under controlled conditions.
A controlled operating condition such as temperature, pressure, speed, curing time, or other specified manufacturing requirement that affects product quality.
Document containing manufacturing and inspection requirements for a production batch.

responsibilities.responsibility: Ensure operators follow approved Work Instructions. Monitor process parameters and production quality. Report deviations immediately.
Ensure manufacturing is carried out as per approved production plans. Allocate resources and monitor production.
Conduct in-process inspections. Verify compliance with specifications. Authorize continuation of production where applicable.
Perform manufacturing activities according to approved Work Instructions. Record required production data. Report abnormalities or equipment issues.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Production shall commence only after:

  • Approved Job Card is available.
  • Required drawings and specifications are available.
  • Required measuring and monitoring equipment is available and, where applicable, calibrated.
  • Raw materials have been accepted.
  • Machines and equipment are ready for use.

Manufacturing shall be carried out under controlled conditions using:

  • Approved Work Instructions
  • Approved process parameters
  • Suitable machinery and equipment
  • Qualified personnel
  • Approved measuring instruments
  • Applicable Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs)

Production Supervisors and Quality personnel shall monitor manufacturing to ensure:

  • Product conforms to specifications.
  • Process parameters remain within approved limits.
  • In-process inspections are completed.
  • Deviations are identified and addressed promptly.
  • Production records are completed during the manufacturing process.

Any deviation from approved drawings, specifications, or process requirements shall be reported to the Production Manager and Quality Department.

Affected products shall be identified, segregated where applicable, and controlled in accordance with SOP013 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs Procedure.

On completion of manufacturing:

  • Production records shall be completed and verified.
  • Products shall be transferred for final inspection.
  • Batch identification and traceability shall be maintained.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for planning, reviewing, verifying, validating, controlling, and documenting the design and development of new or modified products to ensure that customer, statutory, regulatory and applicable requirements are fulfilled.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to the design and development of new products, customer-specific modifications, reverse engineering, manufacturing drawings, tooling designs and engineering changes carried out by Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

references.reference: SOP004 – Customer Communication, Sales & Contract Review

definitions.definition: A systematic process of converting customer, statutory and technical requirements into product designs, drawings, and specifications.
Requirements used as the basis for product design, including customer specifications, standards and statutory requirements.
Approved drawings, specifications, BOMs, manufacturing instructions and technical documents resulting from the design process.
Any approved modification made to an existing design, drawing or specification.
Confirmation that design outputs meet the specified design input requirements.
Confirmation that the final product fulfills its intended use or application.

responsibilities.responsibility: Approve major design projects and design changes.
Prepare designs, drawings, calculations, and technical documents.
Participate in design reviews and verify compliance with customer, statutory and quality requirements.
Review manufacturability of the design.
Communicate customer requirements and approvals.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Design activities shall be planned considering:

  • Customer requirements
  • Product application
  • Technical feasibility
  • Manufacturing capability
  • Applicable standards
  • Required resources.

Design inputs may include:

  • Customer drawings
  • Technical specifications
  • Samples
  • Reverse engineering data
  • Applicable standards
  • Previous design experience
  • Statutory requirements

Inputs shall be reviewed for adequacy before commencing design.

The Design Department shall prepare:

  • Engineering drawings
  • CAD models
  • Bills of Materials (BOM)
  • Material specifications
  • Manufacturing requirements
  • Product specifications

Design reviews shall be conducted at appropriate stages to verify:

  • Customer requirements are addressed.
  • Manufacturing feasibility.
  • Inspection requirements.
  • Material suitability.
  • Cost considerations.

Verification shall confirm that the design outputs meet the approved design inputs through activities such as:

  • Drawing review
  • Dimension verification.
  • Engineering calculations
  • Design review meetings.

Where applicable, validation shall confirm that the product performs as intended through:

  • Prototype evaluation.
  • Sample approval.
  • Customer approval
  • Product performance testing
  • Field trials

All design changes shall be reviewed, approved, and documented before implementation.

Changes shall consider:

  • Product performance
  • Manufacturing impact
  • Customer requirements
  • Existing inventory
  • Inspection requirements
Design drawings, specifications, revisions, approvals, and related records shall be maintained as documented information in accordance with SOP001 – Control of Documented Information.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for the preservation, storage, packing, handling, and dispatch of products to ensure that product conformity is maintained from completion of manufacturing until delivery to the customer.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all raw materials, semi-finished products, finished products, packing materials, storage activities, handling, and dispatch operations carried out at Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

references.reference: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6 – Release of Products & Services

definitions.definition: Activities performed to maintain product conformity during storage, handling, packing and transportation.
Controlled keeping of materials or products before use or dispatch.
Activities performed to protect products during storage and transportation.
Release and shipment of approved products to the customer.

responsibilities.responsibility: Transfer finished products to the designated storage area after production completion.
Verify product acceptance before packing and dispatch.
Store products under suitable conditions. Maintain product identification and stock control.
Pack products as per customer or company requirements. Verify dispatch documents and arrange shipment.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Products shall be handled using suitable methods and equipment to prevent:

  • Damage
  • Deterioration
  • Contamination
  • Mix-up
  • Loss of identification

Accepted materials and finished products shall be stored:

  • In designated storage locations
  • Under suitable environmental conditions
  • With proper identification
  • To prevent damage, deterioration or contamination

Suitable preservation methods shall be applied where necessary, including:

  • Protective packing
  • Rust preventive treatment
  • Dust and moisture protection
  • Safe stacking
  • Protection against physical damage

Products shall be packed in accordance with:

  • Customer requirements
  • Product specifications
  • Transport conditions
  • Internal packing standards

Packing shall ensure adequate protection against damage during storage and transportation.

Where applicable, the following shall be verified before packing:

  • Product identification
  • Quantity
  • Packing materials
  • Labels
  • Customer-specific marking requirements

Only products released by the Quality Department shall be dispatched.

Before dispatch, the Dispatch Department shall verify:

  • Product quantity
  • Product identification
  • Packing condition
  • Delivery Challan
  • Invoice (where applicable)
  • Customer-specific dispatch requirements

Products shall be transported using suitable vehicles and handling methods to prevent damage during transit.

Special transportation requirements specified by the customer shall be complied with wherever applicable.

sop.purpose: To establish a system for identifying materials, components, semi-finished products, and finished products throughout the manufacturing process to ensure traceability and prevent product mix-up.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all incoming materials, work-in-progress (WIP), finished products, and dispatched products manufactured by Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

references.reference: SOP006 – Incoming Material Inspection & Material Identification

definitions.definition: Method of recognizing a product, material, or batch by a unique marking or label.
Ability to trace the history, application, and location of a product through recorded identification.
A quantity of products manufactured under similar conditions and identified by a unique batch number.
The current acceptance status of a product or material, such as Accepted, Rejected, Under Inspection, or Hold.

responsibilities.responsibility: Maintain product identification throughout manufacturing. Ensure batch details are recorded on Job Cards.
Verify identification and traceability during inspection. Ensure inspection status is properly indicated.
Identify and label incoming materials. Maintain identification and segregation of materials during storage and issue.

procedure_steps.step_content: All incoming materials shall be identified using supplier markings, batch numbers, heat numbers, or internal labels, as applicable. Materials shall retain their identification until issued for production.

During manufacturing, products shall be identified by appropriate means such as:

  • Job Card Number
  • Batch Number
  • Product Code
  • Customer Name (where applicable)

Identification shall be maintained throughout all production stages.

Finished products shall be identified with applicable information such as:

  • Product Name / Part Number
  • Batch Number
  • Quantity
  • Inspection Status
  • Customer Name (where applicable)

Inspection status shall be clearly indicated to prevent unintended use or dispatch of unapproved products.

Status may include:

  • Accepted
  • Rejected
  • Under Inspection
  • Hold (where applicable)

Where traceability is required by the customer, regulatory requirements, or internal quality requirements, records shall enable tracing of:

  • Raw materials
  • Supplier (where applicable)
  • Manufacturing batch
  • Inspection records
  • Final product
  • Dispatch details

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for the monitoring, measurement, inspection and testing of products at the incoming, in-process and final stages, so that conformity to specified requirements is verified and evidenced before release.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all inspection and testing of purchased materials, work-in-progress and finished products at Hatim Carbon Company Private Limited.

references.reference: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1.1 – Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation
ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6 – Release of Products and Services
SOP006 – Incoming Material Inspection & Material Identification
SOP017 – Control of Monitoring & Measuring Equipment (Calibration)

definitions.definition: Examination of a product against specified requirements, recorded as a Quality Inspection.
The limits or requirements a characteristic must satisfy for the product to be accepted.
Authorisation for a product to proceed to the next stage or to dispatch after satisfactory inspection.

responsibilities.responsibility: Define inspection stages, templates and acceptance criteria. Review inspection results and authorise release. Ensure inspection is performed with calibrated equipment.
Ensure in-process and final inspections are carried out and recorded before products move to the next stage.
Ensure incoming material is presented for inspection before acceptance into stock.

procedure_steps.step_content: Monitoring and measurement shall be carried out at three stages: incoming inspection of purchased material (SOP001-referenced in SOP006), in-process inspection during manufacturing (SOP008), and final inspection before release for dispatch.
Each inspection shall be recorded as a Quality Inspection in ERPNext, identifying the item, the batch or work order, the characteristics checked, the person inspecting, and the result.

Inspection shall be performed against approved drawings, specifications and customer requirements. Observations shall be recorded against the defined acceptance criteria of the applicable inspection template.

The inspection result determines the product status in accordance with SOP011 – Identification & Traceability. Rejected material shall be handled in accordance with SOP013 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs.
Only products with satisfactory completion of all specified inspection and testing shall be released. Release evidence shall accompany the dispatch documents where required by the customer.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for identifying, segregating, evaluating, and controlling nonconforming materials and products to prevent their unintended use or delivery.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to incoming materials, work-in-progress (WIP), finished products, and externally provided products that do not conform to specified requirements.

definitions.definition: Failure to meet a specified requirement.
Any material or product that does not comply with applicable specifications, drawings, standards, or customer requirements.
The decision taken regarding a nonconforming product, such as rework, repair, acceptance under concession, return, or scrap.

responsibilities.responsibility: Stop further processing of identified nonconforming products. Carry out approved rework or correction, where applicable.
Identify and record nonconforming products. Segregate affected products. Evaluate the nonconformity. Recommend appropriate disposition.
Coordinate with suppliers regarding nonconforming incoming materials.
Approve customer concessions or major disposition decisions, where required.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Nonconformities may be identified during:

  • Incoming inspection
  • In-process inspection
  • Final inspection
  • Customer complaints
  • Internal audits
  • Production activities

All identified nonconforming products shall be clearly marked to prevent unintended use.
Where practical, nonconforming materials or products shall be segregated and kept in a designated Nonconforming Material Area until disposition is decided.

The Quality Department, in consultation with the relevant department, shall evaluate the nonconformity and determine the appropriate disposition.

Possible dispositions include:

  • Rework
  • Repair
  • Re-grade for an alternative application
  • Return to supplier
  • Acceptance under approved concession
  • Scrap
Products that have been reworked or repaired shall be re-inspected before being released for further processing or dispatch.
Where a nonconformity affects customer requirements or delivery commitments, the customer shall be informed whenever necessary and approval obtained before release under concession.
All nonconformities and their dispositions shall be recorded and reviewed to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for identifying the root causes of nonconformities, implementing corrective actions, and verifying their effectiveness to prevent recurrence.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all nonconformities arising from products, processes, customer complaints, supplier issues, internal audits, external audits, and the Quality Management System (QMS).

definitions.definition: Action taken to eliminate the root cause of a detected nonconformity to prevent its recurrence.
The underlying reason that caused a nonconformity.
Evaluation to confirm that the corrective action has successfully prevented recurrence.

responsibilities.responsibility: Investigate causes within their departments. Implement agreed corrective actions. Provide evidence of completion.
Record and investigate nonconformities. Coordinate root cause analysis. Monitor implementation of corrective actions. Verify effectiveness before closure.
Review significant corrective actions. Provide necessary resources and support.

procedure_steps.step_content:
Corrective actions may be initiated from:

  • Customer complaints
  • Product nonconformities
  • Supplier issues
  • Internal audits
  • External audits
  • Management Review
  • Process performance analysis.

The responsible department shall investigate the root cause using suitable methods such as:

  • 5 Why Analysis
  • Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram
  • Process Review
  • Data Analysis

The objective is to eliminate the cause rather than only correcting the immediate issue.

Based on the investigation, an action plan shall be prepared, including:

  • Corrective actions to be implemented.
  • Responsible person
  • Target completion date
  • Required resources.
The assigned department shall implement the approved corrective actions within the agreed timeframe.

The Quality Department shall verify that:

  • The corrective action has been completed.
  • The nonconformity has not recurred.
  • The action has effectively addressed the root cause.

Where necessary, additional actions shall be initiated.

Corrective actions shall be closed only after satisfactory verification of effectiveness.

Records shall be retained as documented information.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for planning, conducting, reporting, and following up internal audits to verify the effectiveness and conformity of the Quality Management System (QMS).
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all departments, processes, and activities covered under the QMS of Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.definition: A systematic and independent assessment conducted to verify conformity and effectiveness of the QMS.
Result of evaluating audit evidence against audit criteria.
Planned schedule of internal audits for a defined period.

responsibilities.responsibility: Conduct audits objectively. Record observations and findings. Prepare audit reports.
Prepare the annual audit programme. Assign competent auditors. Review audit reports. Monitor closure of audit findings.
Cooperate during audits. Implement corrective actions for audit findings. Provide evidence of closure.

procedure_steps.step_content:
An annual Internal Audit Programme shall be prepared considering:

  • Importance of processes
  • Previous audit results
  • Customer complaints
  • Process performance
  • Changes affecting the QMS

Audits shall be conducted using approved checklists and objective evidence through:

  • Interviews
  • Observation of activities
  • Review of documents and records

Auditors shall remain independent of the area being audited, wherever practicable.

Audit findings shall be classified as:

  • Conformity
  • Observation
  • Opportunity for Improvement
  • Nonconformity

The audit report shall be issued to the concerned department.
Departments shall investigate nonconformities and implement corrective actions in accordance with SOP014 – Corrective Action Procedure.
The Quality Manager shall verify the effectiveness of corrective actions before closing audit findings.

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for Top Management to review the suitability, adequacy, effectiveness, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS).
sop.scope: This procedure applies to Management Review Meetings conducted for all processes and departments covered under the QMS of Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.definition: A formal review conducted by Top Management to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of the QMS.
Quality Management System established in accordance with ISO 9001:2015.

responsibilities.responsibility: Conduct Management Review Meetings. Evaluate QMS performance. Approve actions for continual improvement. Allocate necessary resources.
Schedule Management Review Meetings. Prepare meeting agenda and performance data. Record meeting minutes. Monitor completion of action items.
Present departmental performance. Report quality objectives, process performance, and improvement initiatives. Implement assigned actions.

procedure_steps.step_content: Management Review Meetings shall be conducted at least once every year, or more frequently if required due to significant business or quality-related changes.

Management Review shall consider, as applicable:

  • Status of previous Management Review actions
  • Customer feedback and complaints
  • Changes in external and internal issues
  • Effectiveness of actions taken to address risks and opportunities
  • Adequacy of resources
  • Effectiveness of actions taken from previous management reviews
  • Quality Objectives, KPIs, and process performance
  • Product conformity
  • Internal and external audit results
  • Supplier performance
  • Nonconformities and corrective actions
  • Risks and opportunities
  • Resource requirements
  • Improvement opportunities

Management Review outputs may include decisions regarding:

  • Improvement of the QMS
  • Improvement of products, processes, and services
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Resource requirements
  • Process improvements
  • Changes to Quality Objectives
  • Actions to address risks and opportunities
  • Need for changes to the QMS
The Quality Manager shall monitor the implementation of all agreed actions and report their status during the next Management Review Meeting.

sop.declared_title: Control of Monitoring & Measuring Equipment (Calibration) Procedure
sop.purpose: To ensure that monitoring and measuring equipment used for inspection and testing is identified, calibrated, maintained, and fit for its intended purpose to provide reliable measurement results.
sop.scope: This procedure applies to all monitoring and measuring equipment used for product inspection, testing, and quality verification at Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.definition: Comparison of a measuring instrument against a recognized standard to verify its accuracy.
Instruments used to inspect, test, or measure product characteristics.
The current validity of an instrument's calibration.

responsibilities.responsibility: Maintain the list of monitoring and measuring equipment. Prepare and monitor the calibration schedule. Verify calibration status before use. Maintain calibration records.
Handle measuring equipment carefully. Verify calibration labels before use. Report damage, malfunction, or overdue calibration immediately.
Ensure only calibrated equipment is used. Report damaged or malfunctioning equipment.

procedure_steps.step_content: All monitoring and measuring equipment shall be assigned a unique identification number and entered into the Monitoring & Measuring Instruments Register (REG011).

Equipment shall be calibrated:

  • At defined intervals.
  • Before first use (where applicable).
  • After repair or major maintenance.
  • Whenever accuracy is suspected.

Where applicable, calibration shall be traceable to national or international measurement standards.

Each calibrated instrument shall be identified with a calibration label indicating:

  • Equipment ID
  • Date of calibration
  • Due date for next calibration
  • Calibration status (where applicable)

Monitoring and measuring equipment shall be:

  • Protected from damage.
  • Stored appropriately after use.
  • Handled carefully to maintain accuracy.
  • Protected against unauthorized adjustment.

If any equipment is found to be damaged, out of calibration, or unsuitable for use:

  • It shall be identified and removed from service.
  • The impact on previous inspection or measurement results shall be evaluated.
  • Necessary corrective actions shall be initiated in accordance with SOP014 – Corrective Action Procedure. Where affected products are identified, they shall be evaluated in accordance with SOP013 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs Procedure.
Calibration records shall be maintained and reviewed periodically to ensure equipment remains fit for use.

records_generated.title: Calibration Certificates (from external laboratory, where applicable)

sop.purpose: To establish a systematic process for the planned preventive and corrective maintenance of machinery, equipment, utilities, and infrastructure to ensure their continued availability, reliability, and safe operation.
sop.scope: Applies to all production machinery, inspection equipment (excluding calibration activities), utilities, plant infrastructure, and supporting equipment used at Hatim Carbon Co. Pvt. Ltd.

references.reference: SOP017 – Control of Monitoring & Measuring Equipment (Calibration) (where applicable)

definitions.definition: Planned maintenance performed at scheduled intervals to reduce equipment failures.
Maintenance carried out after equipment failure to restore operation.
Activities carried out to keep machinery and equipment in suitable working condition.

responsibilities.responsibility: Plan and carry out preventive and corrective maintenance.
Report equipment abnormalities and stop unsafe equipment.
Ensure equipment is available for scheduled maintenance.
Provide resources for maintenance activities.

procedure_steps.step_content: Maintain a list of all machines and critical equipment in REG020 – Machine & Equipment Register.

Maintenance shall be carried out according to a planned schedule considering:

  • Manufacturer recommendations
  • Equipment usage
  • Operating hours
  • Previous breakdown history

When equipment fails:

  • Stop the machine safely.
  • Raise a Maintenance Request.
  • Diagnose the fault.
  • Repair or replace defective parts.
  • Test before returning to production.

All maintenance activities shall be recorded, including:

  • Date
  • Equipment ID
  • Nature of maintenance
  • Parts replaced
  • Person performing maintenance

After maintenance:

  • Verify machine operation.
  • Confirm safety devices function correctly.
  • Release equipment for production.
Maintenance history shall be reviewed periodically to identify recurring failures and improvement opportunities.
